name: E6_cost
title: Cost of the two drift-compensation nodes: settling delay, static search energy, data-line and match-line energy, area and update overhead (sky130, nominal devices, E4 forests)

models.note: tt, 27 C; the E3b/E4 subset (nfet_01v8, nfet_01v8_lvt, pfet_01v8)

circuit.criterion: V_sw = gate voltage at which the pull-down conducts 100 nA * W/L with V_DS = 1.8 V (E1-E5); V_sp: L6T V_sw, UINV V_Y* (inverter output = V_sw), LBUF V_X* (two inverters, output = V_sw)
circuit.supplies: each branch type has its own V_SL = V_sp,nom + D at t0 (E4)
circuit.map: per cell set, M_f(x) = I_0^-1(f G(x) D) on the nominal divider curve of the lower type at V_DS = V_sp,nom(lower); f = 1 (M0) or a (input remap)
circuit.programming: nominal threshold verify: G_k(theta) = I_div(M0(theta), V_DS = V_sp,k) / D (equals G(theta) for the lower type)
circuit.ml_drain: pull-down drain held at 1.8 V (precharged match line), source and body at 0; its current is the match-line discharge and is not counted as static power
circuit.c_par_note: parasitic capacitance from the divider node (X or Y) to ground: PCM electrode and local wiring (assumption, decision D1)

nodes.dac_remap: a G, V_SL nominal, map M_a
nodes.supply: a G, V_SL = V_sp,nom + D / a, map M0

settle.tolerance_note: the decision node (pull-down gate) must stay inside the band of its DC values for inputs theta - 0.01 LSB and theta + 0.01 LSB (decision D2)
settle.note: DL source: PWL from M(x_prev) to M(theta), edge at t_edge, linear over t_rise; t_settle = last exit from the band minus t_edge
settle.spice_options_note: tight tolerances: the default reltol (1e-3) leaves up to about 1 mV at the divider node, which the inverter gain (about 500 for LBUF) turns into several hundred mV at the decision node

sensitivity.note: C_par 0 and 2 fF are run on t0 and both nodes after one year at four levels

power.counted: V_SL * I(SL source) + V_DD * I(inverter supply source); the pull-down current (match-line discharge) is excluded
power.wildcards: unconstrained bounds are bypassed and draw no current (E4)
power.window: energy per search = mean static power x (t_s(n_features) + largest settling time of the branch types of the cell set at that node and time) (decision D3)

ml.sense_time: t_s(N) as in E3c/E4: nominal cell-under-test pull-down at V_sw, all other 2N - 1 gates at 0 V

dl.drain: divider drain held at V_sp,nom of its branch type during the gate-charge ramp
dl.energy: a rising DL draws V_DD x (Q(V_new) - Q(V_old)) per divider from the supply; a falling DL draws nothing; two dividers per cell on one DL; every row of the array has a cell in every feature column

overhead.lut_note: input remap: one rewritable look-up table per cell set, 2^input_bits entries x b_DL bits (b_DL from E5.3: full-scale DL resolution); counted as sky130_fd_sc_hd__dfxtp_1 flip-flops

checks.C1: DC at x = theta: |V_gate - V_sw| / s <= 0.001 LSB, s = |dV_gate/dx| per LSB from the band; every branch type, level, node and time except UINV with the input remap (shared data line, see C1b)
checks.C2: transient at t_stop inside the tolerance band (settled) and |V_gate(t_stop) - V_gate,DC(theta)| / s <= 0.001 LSB
checks.C3: L6T at t0: SL current at x = theta equals G(theta) D within 0.5 %
checks.C4: largest settling time per (design, type, node, time) over the cases run at every C_par (sensitivity levels and times, both x_prev; unsettled counts as infinite) does not decrease with C_par (0, 0.5, 2 fF) (plan v1.1)
checks.C5: forest-average static power with 2001 instead of 1001 x points changes by <= 0.5 %
checks.C1b: UINV with the input remap after one year: largest residual |V_gate - V_sw| / s over the levels within 10 % (or 0.002 LSB) of E4 check C2: 6T2M P1 0.103, P3 0.225 LSB; GS P1 0.0043, P3 0.0072 LSB

decision: KID confirmed D1-D6 as proposed (question sent 2026-10-24 06:14 JST, answer received by 09:01 JST) (C_par 0.5 fF with 0 and 2 fF sensitivity; band +-0.01 LSB; energy window t_s + largest settling time; 8-bit input LUT; counts plus flip-flop area bound; compact cost table in Section VIII, details in Supplementary S9)
